about: A tool that turns Markdown files into a documentation website.

prs.title: Moving a site over from MkDocs gives a working sidebar
prs.broken: Importing an MkDocs site built a broken sidebar: some links went to pages that did not exist, plugin names showed up as menu items, and quoted titles kept their quotes.
prs.changed: The importer now reads only the menu section, links folder home pages correctly and drops the quotes.
prs.matters: People switching from MkDocs get a sidebar that works the first time.
